title: Unit – 2 : Session – 6 : SLO – 1 | User-Defined vs Predefined Functions
sections: Type classification: A. sum(5,10) call → User-Defined (calls our own method). B. sum definition → User-Defined. C. System.out.println → Predefined (Java library). D. import java.util.Scanner → Predefined (library import). E. new Scanner(System.in) → Predefined (library class). F. Math.sqrt(64) → Predefined (Java library).
Order in a working program: D (import first) → B (method definition in class) → then in main: E (create Scanner) → C (print welcome) → A (call sum) → F (call Math.sqrt).
